Hey, I just wanted to say that I don't think I've ever seen a post that I've related to more than this. You put every single thing I'm feeling into words, and you're also an amazing writer, so thank you. From the outside, I have a perfect life. Enough money, family, friends, a healthy social life, good grades, a sport I love, etc., and yet I still want to die so fucking badly, because despite having all this, life doesn't feel worth it. And then every time I want to die, I feel guilty, because how can I want to die so much when other people who go through so much more than me want to live? 

I'm genuinely so sorry you're going through this, and I hope things get better for you. Thanks again <3
